sentences.en: Your top does not provide enough midriff coverage, young lady.
sentences.zh: 你的上衣对腹部的覆盖不够，小姐。

sentences.en: The squadron encountered an ambush and scrambled for coverage.
sentences.zh: 中队遭遇伏击，赶紧找地方掩护。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to ensure health coverage to most of its population.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要确保大部分人口都能享有医疗保障。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：cover（覆盖）+age（总称）→覆盖范围
